'''2003 Georgia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Georgia (17 May 2003). [[Clint Hays]] won the Day 2 bye.<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref> It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Georgia
* '''Dates:''' 17 May 2003<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Venue:''' T & T Toys, Duluth, Georgia<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[John Anderson]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Clint Hays]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
